FN-RBRWRMY-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 520
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Marcus Paramore
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/02/2026
House Bill 520 as introduced could increase the obligations of the local boards of education by
an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of relocation stipends or hiring incentives
paid by boards that elect to offer such incentives to individuals that relocate from another state
and are certified to teach career and technical education courses pursuant to this bill.
Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board of
Education and the Alabama Department of Education to adopt rules to establish the expedited
teacher certificates pursuant to this bill and to provide an annual report on the efficacy of the
program.
